title: As Intended: Elementalist
summary: On the morning of Commencement you stated the discipline you intended to be named into, and the Register wrote it in the margin. The line it was writing for you stopped at the Sundering. It finishes in the Grand Hall, once someone is left who can teach Elementalist.

objectives.text: Find someone left who can teach Elementalist
Earn Elementalist mastery
Reopen the Grand Hall
Pass the Elementalist practical: the Frost Plate
Be named into the discipline of the Elementalists
objectives.doneText: Named into the discipline of the Elementalists. As intended.
